verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers accessing sensitive verification results, webhooks, review tools and blocklists. It contains no documented data-retention windows and no redaction or deletion API for scrubbing collected PII. Data-lifecycle control is a fair question for an identity-verification product, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
